title: G8 compare verdict (eval before/after)
description: Verdict produced by resecta_data.eval.compare from two derived g8_detection_baseline.json dicts (a BEFORE and an AFTER). Pure arithmetic over the frozen baseline cells: the four-clause §3 predicate per scorer family and over the grand-total aggregate, plus the per-doctype / per-demographic slice non-regression guard. Dev/eval artifact: not installed to the Swift Resources path, not produced by make build. Carries both input SHA-256 digests for provenance.

schema_version.description: Wire-format version. Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this verdict.

before_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical-encoded BEFORE baseline dict. A hash of the comparator input, not a wall-clock, so the verdict stays determinism-safe.

after_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical-encoded AFTER baseline dict.

thresholds.description: The predicate thresholds applied. delta_p and delta_slice are precision fractions (e.g. 0.05 for 5 points); eps and delta_f_rel are fractions throughout.

delta_p.description: Minimum precision uplift demanded by C1, as a fraction.

delta_f_rel.description: Minimum relative family-FPR cut demanded by C2, as a fraction.

eps.description: Recall floor slack allowed by C3, as a fraction.

delta_slice.description: Maximum tolerated per-slice precision drop in C4, as a fraction.

regression.description: True when any gating clause fails on any scorer family or on the aggregate. An aggregate pass does not excuse a per-family failure.

families.description: One verdict record per scorer family, in account/phone/mrn/ein/itin order. An absent family (e.g. ITIN off the G8 panel) is reported as a tolerated absence rather than evaluated.

aggregate.description: The grand-total verdict: the four-clause predicate over totals plus the C4 slice non-regression guard.

clause.description: One predicate clause result carrying two senses: win (the §3 improvement bar is met) and regressed (the metric got worse beyond tolerance). Failing to improve is not a regression. Extra numeric fields carry the before/after measured values and the clause-specific slack.

win.description: True when this clause's improvement bar is satisfied (AFTER vs BEFORE).

regressed.description: True when this clause's metric got worse beyond the float-noise tolerance.

familyVerdict.description: Per-family verdict. Either an evaluated family (carries clauses, win, regressed_clauses) or a tolerated absence (carries absent + note).

name.description: Scorer family name (account, phone, mrn, ein, itin).

regression.description: True when a gating clause regressed for this family. Always false for a tolerated absence.

win.description: True when this family clears its improvement bar: every gating clause's win sense for uplift-required families, or simply no-regression for a non-regression-only family.

non_regression_only.description: True for a family clean on G8 (MRN/EIN): the C1 precision clause does not gate (a precision drop with still-zero FP is not flagged), while the C2 FP-growth and C3 recall-drop clauses still gate.

regressed_clauses.description: Identifiers of the gating clauses that regressed for this family.

clauses.description: The evaluated clause results for this family.

low_confidence.description: Advisory: true when either side flags this family low-support. Reported, never gated.

absent.description: True when the family has no per_family entry in the baselines (off the G8 panel); the family is tolerated, not evaluated.

note.description: Mechanism-language operator note (e.g. an off-panel marker).

aggregateVerdict.description: The grand-total verdict. Like a family verdict but its clause list also carries the C4 slice non-regression result.

regression.description: True when a gating clause regressed on the aggregate (including the C4 slice guard).

win.description: True when the aggregate clears every gating clause's improvement bar, including the C4 slice non-regression clause.

non_regression_only.description: Always false for the aggregate (the aggregate is gated on uplift like a scored family).

regressed_clauses.description: Identifiers of the gating clauses the aggregate regressed on.

clauses.description: The aggregate clause results, including the C4 slice non-regression clause.

low_confidence.description: Advisory low-support flag carried from the totals cell.
